div.l: No wondyr is he herd it al the day
And eke ye knowe wel that a Iay
Can clepe watte as wel as can the pope
But who coude hym in other thyngys grope
Than had he spent al hys phylosofye
Ay questio quid queris wolde he crye
He was a gentyl harlot and a kynde
A better felow shold men not fynde
He wold suffre for a quart of wyn
A good felow to haue hys concubyn
A twelf monthe ⁊and excuse hym at the fulle
Ful pryuely a fynche eke coude he pulle
And yf he fond owher a good felawe
He wold teche hym anon to haue awe
In suche caas of the archedekenes curs
But yf mannys soule were in hys purs
For in hys purs he shold punysshyd be
Purs is the archedekenes helle sayd he
But wel I woot he lied right in dede
Of cursynge owght eche man to drede
For cursynge wyl sle right as soylyng saueth
And also ware hym of a significauit
In daunger hadde he at hys owen gyse
Alle the yong gyrlis of the dyocyse
And knew of hyr counseyl ⁊and was of her rede
A garlond he hadde set vp on hys hede
As greet as it were an alestake
A bokeler hadde he made hym of a Cake
